title: FATEX
description: Bored? Like really bored? Let's fix that. Vanilla feel with extra sauce — custom classes, new bosses, unique items, new mechanics & more to discover. We've been perfecting this since 2019.
body:
![server description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/63e427fe2e835f7fe570ccb0392e1793a3524755_0.webp)

# **Choose Your Class**

Every class rewrites the rules of how you fight. Open /class and pick an identity — your base stats shift, your model changes, and a unique skill set becomes yours. Trigger them with specific item combos, burn them for 30 seconds of chaos, then wait for cooldown.

The Faker vanishes in a burst of speed and leaping aggression — a predator built for ambushes. The Archer turns every arrow into a lightning rod. And those are just the ones we'll show you.

![class](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7874cf4943df8cd339a58eded3b174b317549ce4.png)

# **Gear That Rolls the Dice**
Every craft is a gamble. Stats are randomised on creation — your stone sword might come out with a savage buff, or a nasty debuff. Level up and the rolls get better. Some items auto-upgrade to the next tier and keep their unique stats — so your two-handed stone sword could become a two-handed diamond sword.

Rarer items can roll extra gem slots. Bosses drop gear you can't craft. The Ender Dragon drops the Eridium set. Wither Skeletons carry swords locked to level 40+. Never stop hunting.


![gear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/64e58a190d0578ee6594ccccb3b44c48b14f3871.png)

# **Cosmo Stones — Infinity-Level Power**
These aren't upgrades. They're insurance — and they're rare. Three tiers: Impure, Clone, Real. The higher the tier, the closer to true power. Socket them. Protect your best gear. Identify the unidentifiable.

![cosmo stones](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d05986c7516f0cdaf9edff004fb1d079252d154a.png)

# **The Grind — Level Your Way**
Death doesn't delete your progress. Ever. Professions feed into your main level — two systems, one character. Mobs scale around you: Overworld enemies are ~30% weaker, Nether hits harder.
![levels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e75fc58da68959c01479a7dab5bcc787bb105f38.png)
